title: Snap tries to make the case again for its $2,200 smart glasses
slides: Would you pay $2,200 for Snap's smart glasses?
Snap's new Spectacles are for developers only.
But they now work outdoors and last longer.
Developers can now order them in the US.
Ask your team: would this replace any tool?
thread_text:
1. The $2,200 gamble

Snap's new Spectacles are for developers only, but they finally work outdoors and last longer. You can order them in the US starting today.

2. Developers only, for now

Snap is limiting sales to developers building AR experiences. That means you can't just buy them as a consumer yet.

3. Outdoors and longer lasting

The new Spectacles now work in bright sunlight and have extended battery life. No more being tethered to indoor spaces.

4. Order now in the US

Developers in the US can place orders immediately. Shipping and pricing details are available on Snap's website.

5. Would this replace your tool?

Ask your team: could these glasses replace any current workflow? Try a specific use case this week and see if it sticks.

instagram.caption:
$2,200 for glasses that only developers can buy right now. 🤖

Snap opened US orders for its new Spectacles, but sales stay limited to developers building AR experiences. Consumers can't just buy them yet.

They now work in bright sunlight and last longer on battery.

If you create AR content, this is a tool you can actually test outdoors now — not another indoor demo.

Would your team swap any current workflow for these? Try one real use case this week before judging. 👓
